# netbox_device_role (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/devices/#device-roles):

> Devices can be organized by functional roles, which are fully customizable by the user. For example, you might create roles for core switches, distribution switches, and access switches within your network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Device role for physical devices only
resource "netbox_device_role" "core_sw" {
  color_hex = "ff00ff"
  name      = "core-sw"
  vm_role   = false
}

# Device role that can be used for both devices and virtual machines
resource "netbox_device_role" "web_server" {
  color_hex   = "00ff00"
  name        = "web-server"
  description = "Web server role"
  vm_role     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color_hex` (String) The color hex of the device role.
- `name` (String) The name of the device role.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the device role.
- `config_template_id` (Number) The ID of the config template associated with the device role.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the device role.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the device role. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `parent_id` (Number) The ID of the parent associated with the device role.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the device role.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `vm_role` (Boolean) Virtual machines may be assigned to this role. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_device_role.example 1
```
